Third-party libraries bundled in this folder

- pdf-lib (MIT) https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
- @pdf-lib/fontkit (MIT) https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit
- pdfjs-dist (Apache-2.0) https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- JSZip (MIT / GPLv3 dual) https://github.com/Stuk/jszip
- Sarabun font (SIL Open Font License 1.1) https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Sarabun
